GROUNDING COMPLETE (4 Explore sweeps + firsthand reads; full reports archived in session scratchpad p3-sweeps/). Load-bearing findings for the plan: (1) Nothing of governing section 11's history model exists in code: no materialization field on RepoHistoryRecord/AmbiguousNamespaceRecord (CatalogSnapshotV2 is deny_unknown_fields, so adding it is a catalog format change; governing 5.1's claim that Phase 1 wrote NotBuilt did NOT ship), no RepoHistoryGeneration/Quarantine types, no rebuild manifest, no GitOverlaySelector. (2) Phase 1's namespace commitments (LegacyCommitNamespaceInventoryV1: per-namespace commit-doc count+commitment, vector-key count+commitment) are computed but NEVER persisted - only the aggregate inventory_hash lands in receipts; the materializer needs a persisted namespace-inventory immutable asset (project-catalog-migration-assets mechanism exists) or full re-capture. (3) The destructive replacement is live: INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION mismatch does remove_dir_all with a preservation guard for collected code only; commit docs are permanently lost for attachment-less projects. The version bump Phase 3 itself needs MUST NOT ship before the materializer + guard. (4) Remote-only projects have no ProjectRecord row (CatalogProjectRecordsProvider omits them from .records while corpus_project_ids includes them): activation dies with "registered project disappeared", reindex planning/preservation never sees them (purge hazards H1 full/H2 incremental/H3 empty-root), runtime edge rebuild (routes.rs:1960) and background storage GC (server/storage_gc.rs:57) use .records while startup/MCP use corpus_project_ids - live divergences; GC deletes remote-only sidecars after 30-day fuse. (5) Filter gap: project_file docs carry project_id but NOT base_project_id; the resolved-id filter lane only targets base_project_id, so removing absolute `project` values orphans project selectors unless a project_id lane is added (one clause). (6) validate_catalog runs on every read+transact; Unclaimed namespaces CANNOT live in the catalog (>=2-candidates rule) - the rebuild manifest is the sole durable owner of unclaimed-generation identity. (7) Reusable substrate: open_bytes blob-resolver seam already exists; collect_preserved_collected_documents is the strict abort-before-delete verification template; MigrationImmutableAssetDraftV1 pattern fits history generations ~1:1; pending-local-activation journal is the crash-recovery analogue for the rebuild manifest; gc_blobs_for_scopes exists with zero production callers; authority_epoch is the natural CodeReadView catalog-epoch carrier; CheckoutAccessSourceLane::LegacyProjectRecord is the complete grep anchor. (8) Embedding text is already path-free; vector keys already path-free; commitment hash excludes path-bearing fields (deliberate, convenient).
